command: set -e; ANDROID_JAR="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platforms/android-36/android.jar"; test -f "$ANDROID_JAR"; echo '=== AudioRecord Builder ==='; javap -classpath "$ANDROID_JAR" 'android.media.AudioRecord$Builder' | sed -n '1,220p'; echo '=== AudioRecord ctors ==='; javap -classpath "$ANDROID_JAR" -p android.media.AudioRecord | sed -n '1,260p'; echo '=== AttributionSource ==='; javap -classpath "$ANDROID_JAR" -p android.content.AttributionSource | sed -n '1,220p'; echo '=== Context methods attribution ==='; javap -classpath "$ANDROID_JAR" android.content.Context | grep -n -E 'Attribution|createPackageContext|createContext' | head -n 80 || true; echo phase2c_audiorecord_attribution_api_inspected=true
